input.message: The topic page was built successfully, but with one important correction to the input sentence: live evidence confirms the 2026 NBA Finals is between the **New York Knicks and the San Antonio Spurs** — not the Oklahoma City Thunder, who were eliminated by the Spurs in Game 7 of the Western Conference Finals. The core claim (Knicks leading the NBA Finals 3-1) is accurate. The rendered page covers the Knicks' 3-1 series lead over the Spurs, highlights from Games 1–4 including the historic Game 4 comeback at Madison Square Garden, key performers (Jalen Brunson, Karl-Anthony Towns, Victor Wembanyama), and the Knicks' pursuit of their first NBA championship since 1973, with all facts cited across five sources from nba.com, The Athletic/NYT, Sporting News, Basketball-Reference, and Wikipedia.
